1 Process Engineer (all genders) Job-ID: 203254 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your roleinvolves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware tomeet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements toensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

In this role you will directly contribute to panel level processes. This is includes electrochemicalmetal deposition and post plating processes, e.g. metal etching. You will focus on developing process for and with customers around the world and cover smallscale and panel level scale processes.

What you'll do
 * Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems
 * Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products
 * Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields
 * Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications
 * Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications
 * Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges
 * Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap
 * Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities

Who we're looking for
Minimum Qualifications:

 * Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years' experience; or equivalent experience
 * Good English oral and written communication skills
 * Structured and organized working style
 * Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a crossfunctional environment

Preferred Qualifications:

 * Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques
 * In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)
 * Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language
 * Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies
 * Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
 * Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD)
 * Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP)
 * Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization
 * Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners
 * Experience in semiconductor, process design, deposition, etch dielectrics or conductor, metal films, etc.

What we're offering
This position is subject to the https://www.metalltechnischeindustrie.at/fileadmin/content/Dokumente/Kollektivvertrag/KV-2025_2026/FMTI_Mindesgehaltstabelle_2025.pdf in occupation group F-G depending on educational background.

jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager - Italian Market (m/f/d) Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the Italian market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of Italian SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, make.com, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * C2 Italian, strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

 

What We Offer

 * €60,000-80,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Regular team offsites

 * Office in Vienna or Barcelona, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 30 min getting to know the country's Go-to-Market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

1 Senior AI Solution Consultant_in Your Tasks
 * Use Case Ownership: Take a broad, messy client ask through to a decision people stand behind, with the business value made explicit and the trade-offs written down.
 * Problem Framing: Make competing asks comparable, decide what gets solved first, and put the reasoning on the table.
 * Stakeholder Reality: Bring the people who ask for a solution and the people who will work with it behind one decision.
 * AI Judgment: Draw the line between what AI should do and what it should not, and say what has to be measured for people to trust the result.
 * Structured Intent: Capture the what and the why, so that engineers and AI agents can build the how.
 * High-Stakes Facilitation: Design and run formats with senior stakeholders from product, engineering and compliance, producing alignment in the room.
 * Rapid Prototyping: Put a working artefact in front of a stakeholder instead of a concept, using today's AI tooling.
 * Client Capability: Build enablement formats, reusable AI artefacts and skills that client teams operate themselves after we leave.
 * Governance Early: Bring classification, controls, auditability and cost implications into the picture at the start, not at the end.
 * Multiplication: Turn what you learn into playbooks and templates your colleagues use in their own delivery.

Your Qualifications
 * Structured Thinking: You give shape to something vague, form a view early, and stay sharp when you go deeper.
 * Product Thinking: Strong instinct for value and users, and you can say what a use case is worth before anyone builds it.
 * Consulting Track Record: Several years in consulting, product or transformation roles, ideally in regulated industries, with topics you carried to a decision rather than only contributed to.
 * AI Judgment: Clear-eyed on where LLMs fit and where they do not, on the failure modes, and on how to prove an output is correct. You work with your own workflows, agents and skills, and stay critical of what comes back.
 * Technical Fluency: Confident in conversations on modern software delivery, LLMs, agents and RAG, without needing to build production systems yourself.
 * Composure: You hold a position under pressure with senior people, and change it when someone brings the better argument.
 * AI Governance is a plus: EU AI Act risk classification, human-in-the-loop, auditability, any exposure to DORA or GDPR/DPIA.
 * Languages: Fluent communication in German and English.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 63.000 
and € 75.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Please refer to the application link for further information
